name: EuRoC MAV
title: The EuRoC micro aerial vehicle datasets

license.en: Consult the ETH Research Collection record; dataset licence was not independently verified in this audit.
license.zh: 以 ETH Research Collection 条目许可为准；本次未独立核验数据许可。

summary.en: Canonical stereo-inertial MAV benchmark with metric motion references; a perspective-camera baseline for wide-FoV VIO studies.
summary.zh: 经典双目惯性无人机基准，提供米制运动参考，可作为广视场 VIO 的透视相机对照。

en.Geometry: Monochrome stereo, 20 Hz; IMU, 200 Hz. Not a panoramic or fisheye release.
en.Ground-truth provenance: Vicon 6DoF pose or Leica laser-tracker 3D position, depending on sequence; structure scans are also available.
en.Calibration and time: Camera intrinsics, camera–IMU extrinsics and aligned references are supplied. Separate reference recording systems leave documented synchronization limits.
en.Evaluation: Use the supplied sensor/body transforms and timestamps; position-only laser measurements do not independently observe every orientation.
en.Download: Official hosting moved to ETH Research Collection.

zh.成像模型: 20 Hz 灰度双目与 200 Hz IMU；不是全景或鱼眼数据。
zh.真值来源: 不同序列采用 Vicon 六自由度位姿或 Leica 激光跟踪三维位置，并提供结构扫描。
zh.标定与时间: 提供相机内参、相机–IMU 外参和已对齐参考；独立参考采集系统仍有文档说明的同步限制。
zh.评测: 使用数据所定义的传感器/机体变换与时间戳；激光仪的纯位置测量不能独立观测所有姿态。
zh.下载: 官方文件已迁移至 ETH Research Collection。

en: No per-frame dense image-depth ground truth is assumed.
Aggressive motion can degrade the laser-tracker reference.
zh: 不将其视为逐帧稠密图像深度真值集。
剧烈运动可能降低激光跟踪参考质量。

evidence.title: ETH ASL: EuRoC MAV dataset and known issues
EuRoC dataset paper

name: TUM RGB-D
title: A Benchmark for the Evaluation of RGB-D SLAM Systems

license.en: CC BY 4.0 data unless otherwise stated; accompanying code BSD-2-Clause.
license.zh: 除另有说明，数据为 CC BY 4.0；附带代码为 BSD-2-Clause。

summary.en: Real Kinect RGB-D sequences with independent motion capture, useful for metric RGB-D SLAM and reconstruction baselines.
summary.zh: 真实 Kinect RGB-D 序列与独立动作捕捉位姿，适合米制 RGB-D SLAM 和重建对照。

en.Inputs: 640×480 RGB and measured depth, nominally 30 Hz; timestamps are provided separately.
en.Depth convention: 16-bit PNG values divided by 5000 give metres; zero indicates missing depth. Released RGB/depth are registered.
en.Pose reference: Motion-capture trajectories at 100 Hz; pose format is timestamp tx ty tz qx qy qz qw in the reference world.
en.Calibration: Use the per-camera parameters and dataset notes; do not apply a second distortion correction to already registered depth.
en.Evaluation: Associate timestamps and apply the published ATE/RPE tools; retain depth holes and masks.

zh.输入: 640×480 RGB 与实测深度，标称 30 Hz；各自提供时间戳。
zh.深度约定: 16 位 PNG 除以 5000 得到米，零值表示缺测；发布的 RGB/深度已经配准。
zh.位姿参考: 100 Hz 动作捕捉轨迹；格式为时间戳、平移 tx ty tz 和四元数 qx qy qz qw。
zh.标定: 使用各相机参数及数据说明；不要对已经配准的深度再次做畸变校正。
zh.评测: 先关联时间戳，再用官方 ATE/RPE 工具；保留深度空洞及有效掩码。

en: Measured Kinect depth is noisy and incomplete, not perfect dense geometry.
Kinect accelerometer data is not a full gyro–accelerometer IMU.
zh: Kinect 实测深度有噪声和缺测，并非完美稠密几何。
Kinect 加速度数据不是完整的陀螺仪–加速度计 IMU。

evidence.title: TUM RGB-D benchmark overview and licence
TUM RGB-D image, depth and pose formats

name: TUM VI
title: The TUM VI Benchmark for Evaluating Visual-Inertial Odometry

license.en: CC BY 4.0 data; accompanying code BSD-2-Clause.
license.zh: 数据为 CC BY 4.0；附带代码为 BSD-2-Clause。

summary.en: Hardware-synchronized 195° stereo fisheye and IMU with photometric calibration; full room trajectories but partial reference elsewhere.
summary.zh: 硬件同步的 195° 双目鱼眼与 IMU，附光度标定；房间序列有完整参考，其他序列通常只有起终段。

en.Inputs: 1024×1024 16-bit linear images at 20 Hz; IMU at 200 Hz. Downsampled exports are also provided.
en.Ground-truth coverage: Room sequences: full motion capture. Corridor, magistrale, outdoors and slides: start/end segments only.
en.Reference frame: Calibrated ground truth is in the IMU frame; corrected timestamps and IMU scaling are already applied.
en.Calibration: Geometric, camera–IMU, exposure/vignette and IMU-noise resources are supplied.
en.Evaluation: Evaluate only reference-covered intervals; endpoint drift is not full-route ATE.

zh.输入: 1024×1024、16 位线性图像，20 Hz；IMU 为 200 Hz，另提供降采样版本。
zh.真值覆盖: room 序列有完整动作捕捉；corridor、magistrale、outdoors、slides 仅起终段有真值。
zh.参考坐标系: 标定版本真值已转到 IMU 坐标系，并已校正时间戳与 IMU 比例。
zh.标定: 提供几何、相机–IMU、曝光/暗角和 IMU 噪声资料。
zh.评测: 仅在真值覆盖区间计算对应误差；端点漂移不等于全程 ATE。

en: No dense depth labels; this is a VIO/SLAM benchmark.
Do not apply raw-clock offsets again to calibrated exports.
zh: 没有稠密深度标签，主要用于 VIO/SLAM。
不要对标定后导出数据重复应用原始时钟偏移。

evidence.title: TUM VI official sequences, calibration, coverage and licence
TUM VI paper

license.en: CC BY-NC-SA 3.0; download registration and KITTI terms apply.
license.zh: CC BY-NC-SA 3.0；下载需注册并遵循 KITTI 条款。

summary.en: Driving stereo/LiDAR odometry baseline with metric reference trajectories and an established subsequence-error protocol.
summary.zh: 经典车载双目/LiDAR 里程计基准，提供米制参考轨迹及成熟的分段误差评测协议。

en.Split: 22 stereo sequences: 00–10 expose reference trajectories; 11–21 withhold them for server evaluation.
en.Geometry: Perspective stereo and Velodyne scans. This entry is separate from KITTI depth prediction/completion.
en.Pose and scale: GPS/OXTS-based metric reference; use the official devkit coordinate and pose conventions.
en.Protocol: Translation/rotation drift over 100–800 m subsequences; report scale alignment explicitly for monocular estimates.
en.Access: Downloads require login; leaderboard submissions have publication and novelty policies.

zh.划分: 22 段双目序列：00–10 公开参考轨迹，11–21 的真值由服务器保留。
zh.成像模型: 透视双目和 Velodyne 扫描；此条目与 KITTI 深度预测/补全分开。
zh.位姿与尺度: GPS/OXTS 米制参考；采用官方开发工具的坐标与位姿约定。
zh.协议: 在 100–800 米子轨迹上评估平移/旋转漂移；单目结果是否对齐尺度需明确报告。
zh.获取: 下载需要登录；榜单提交另有论文及创新性要求。

en: Not native panoramic or fisheye imagery.
Use official training splits for local experiments when server submission criteria do not apply.
zh: 不是原生全景或鱼眼图像。
本地实验可采用公开训练集划分，服务器另有提交条件。

evidence.title: KITTI odometry benchmark splits and evaluation protocol
KITTI official dataset suite

name: KITTI-360
title: KITTI-360: A Novel Dataset and Benchmarks for Urban Scene Understanding in 2D and 3D

license.en: CC BY-NC-SA 3.0; registration and intended-use declaration required.
license.zh: CC BY-NC-SA 3.0；需注册并说明用途。

summary.en: Urban mapping with front perspective stereo plus side 180° fisheye cameras; 360° coverage comes from a rig, not stitched ERP frames.
summary.zh: 前向透视双目加两侧 180° 鱼眼的城市建图数据；360° 覆盖来自相机组，不是拼接 ERP 图像。

en.Ground truth: Georegistered poses are optimized using SfM with GPS and LiDAR constraints, not raw OXTS alone.
en.Coordinates: poses.txt is IMU-to-world; cam0_to_world.txt is rectified camera-0-to-world. Some slowly moving frames lack entries.
en.Depth use: Laser scans and 3D geometry can be projected with the supplied models; this does not guarantee dense per-pixel depth.
en.Calibration: Perspective intrinsics/rectification, fisheye YAMLs and sensor extrinsics are provided.
en.Protocol: Use the localisation/mapping task split; avoid treating derived pose optimization as independent motion capture.

zh.真值: 地理配准位姿由 SfM 加 GPS/LiDAR 约束优化得到，并不等同于原始 OXTS。
zh.坐标约定: poses.txt 为 IMU 到世界；cam0_to_world.txt 为校正后相机 0 到世界；低速运动时部分帧无位姿条目。
zh.深度使用: 可利用官方相机模型投影扫描与三维几何，但不能据此假设每像素都有稠密深度。
zh.标定: 提供透视内参/校正、鱼眼 YAML 和传感器外参。
zh.协议: 按定位/建图任务的划分使用；优化位姿不能当作独立动作捕捉测量。

en: No native panoramic camera tag: the source release is multi-camera.
Depth sparsity, occlusions and scan timing require explicit masks.
zh: 不标为原生全景：源数据发布形式是多相机。
投影深度需显式处理稀疏性、遮挡和扫描时间。

evidence.title: KITTI-360 official sensors, licence and tasks
KITTI-360 optimized poses and calibration conventions

name: TartanAir / V2
title: TartanAir: A Dataset to Push the Limits of Visual SLAM

license.en: Current V2 data: CC BY 4.0; toolkit: MIT. Check the original V1 terms separately.
license.zh: 当前 V2 数据为 CC BY 4.0，工具为 MIT；V1 单独核对许可。

summary.en: Synthetic depth-and-motion family; V2 resamples synchronized cubeface cameras into configurable fisheye and panoramic observations.
summary.zh: 合成深度与运动数据系列；V2 可将同步六面相机重采样为可配置鱼眼和全景观测。

en.Version and year: 2020 is the original paper year; the linked current documentation describes V2, not an unchanged V1 release.
en.Geometry: V2 raw data has two stereo sets of six 90° pinhole views; panorama/fisheye RGB, depth and semantics are resampled.
en.Depth format: Float32 depth is losslessly packed into four-channel PNG. Decode as float32; mask sky/very large values.
en.Poses: Camera translation/quaternions use NED conventions; preserve metric translations and the per-camera frame transforms.
en.Calibration and timing: Simulated views are synchronized; use the selected camera model, sampling rotation and IMU noise configuration.

zh.版本与年份: 2020 为原始论文年份；当前链接文档描述 V2，不是保持不变的 V1 发布。
zh.成像模型: V2 原始数据为两组各六个 90° 透视视图；全景/鱼眼 RGB、深度和语义由此重采样。
zh.深度格式: float32 深度无损打包到四通道 PNG，需按浮点解码，并屏蔽天空/极大值。
zh.位姿: 相机平移/四元数采用 NED 约定；保留米制平移和各相机坐标变换。
zh.标定与时间: 仿真视图已同步；使用选定模型、采样旋转及 IMU 噪声配置。

en: Synthetic ground truth does not establish real-camera calibration robustness.
Confirm Z-depth versus ray-distance semantics in the chosen resampler before evaluating panoramas.
zh: 仿真真值不能证明对真实相机标定误差的鲁棒性。
全景评测前需核对所选重采样器输出的是 Z 深度还是射线距离。

evidence.title: TartanAir V2 official documentation and licence
V2 modalities, depth packing and camera poses
Original TartanAir 2020 paper

license.zh: 数据与基准采用 CC BY-NC-SA 3.0。

summary.en: Wide-FoV multicamera, dual-LiDAR and inertial construction benchmark; sparse surveyed positions must be distinguished from full pose trajectories.
summary.zh: 广视场多相机、双 LiDAR 与惯性的施工环境基准；需区分稀疏测量位置和完整位姿轨迹。

en.Geometry: Five Alphasense cameras cover approximately 270° in total; a physical stereo pair is included. Not a stitched ERP sensor.
en.Ground truth: Most sequences: stationary total-station 3DoF positions. Lab/arena sequences: OptiTrack 6DoF.
en.Accuracy and frame: Official reference accuracy is better than 5 mm; filenames identify the reference frame, e.g. prism.
en.Synchronization: FPGA and PTP synchronization; sensor TF tree, calibration and noise resources are supplied.
en.Evaluation: Compare the correctly transformed reference point at surveyed timestamps; sparse control points cannot support dense trajectory ATE.

zh.成像模型: 五个 Alphasense 相机总覆盖约 270°，包含真实双目；不是拼接 ERP 传感器。
zh.真值: 大多数序列为全站仪在静止时测量的三自由度位置；实验室/测试场序列提供 OptiTrack 六自由度真值。
zh.精度与坐标系: 官方给出参考精度优于 5 毫米；文件名标明参考坐标系，例如棱镜。
zh.同步: 采用 FPGA 和 PTP，同步资料、TF 树、标定及噪声资源随数据提供。
zh.评测: 在测量时刻比较正确变换后的参考点；稀疏控制点不能用于全程稠密轨迹 ATE。

en: Year denotes the 2021 challenge; the journal paper is RA-L 2022.
LiDAR scans are measurements, not complete dense image-depth labels.
zh: 年份对应 2021 挑战；期刊论文发表于 RA-L 2022。
LiDAR 扫描是测量数据，并非完整稠密图像深度标签。

evidence.title: Hilti 2021 official downloads, truth dimensions and licence
Hilti SLAM sensor and calibration paper

name: Hilti-Oxford 2022
title: Hilti-Oxford Dataset: A Millimeter-Accurate Benchmark for Simultaneous Localization and Mapping

license.zh: 数据与基准采用 CC BY-NC-SA 3.0。

summary.en: Five synchronized fisheye cameras, Hesai LiDAR and IMU in construction sites and the Sheldonian Theatre; surveyed control points target millimetre accuracy.
summary.zh: 五个同步鱼眼相机、Hesai LiDAR 与 IMU，覆盖施工现场和谢尔登剧院，以毫米级测量控制点评估。

en.Inputs: Five 40 Hz global-shutter fisheye streams, 400 Hz IMU and 10 Hz Hesai LiDAR.
en.Ground truth: Challenge data uses sparse surveyed 3DoF positions; selected additional sequences provide denser 6DoF references.
en.Reference frame: All released ground-truth data is expressed in the IMU frame.
en.Calibration: Kalibr-like equidistant camera models, camera–IMU calibration recordings, noise data and rig CAD are provided.
en.Protocol: Respect the challenge control-point evaluation; do not assume every frame has millimetre-accurate orientation.

zh.输入: 五路 40 Hz 全局快门鱼眼、400 Hz IMU 与 10 Hz Hesai LiDAR。
zh.真值: 挑战序列采用稀疏测量三维位置；部分附加序列另有更密的六自由度参考。
zh.参考坐标系: 发布的真值统一位于 IMU 坐标系。
zh.标定: 提供类似 Kalibr 的等距畸变参数、相机–IMU 标定记录、噪声资料和机架 CAD。
zh.协议: 采用挑战控制点评测；不能假设每帧都有毫米级姿态。

en: 2022 denotes challenge release; the journal citation is RA-L 2023.
Five fisheye views are a camera rig, not a single ERP panorama.
zh: 2022 为挑战发布年份，期刊引用为 RA-L 2023。
五路鱼眼是相机组，不是单幅 ERP 全景。

evidence.title: Hilti-Oxford official ground-truth coverage and licence
Hilti-Oxford camera model, synchronization and reference methodology

name: Newer College
title: The Newer College Dataset: Handheld LiDAR, Inertial and Vision with Ground Truth

license.en: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; intended for non-commercial academic use.
license.zh: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0，面向非商业学术用途。

summary.en: Hand-carried mapping family with original stereo and a 2021 multicamera extension; independent survey maps anchor metric trajectory references.
summary.zh: 手持建图数据系列，包括原始双目和 2021 年多相机扩展，利用独立测量地图建立米制轨迹参考。

en.Versions: Original: RealSense D435i and Ouster OS1. Extension: four Alphasense cameras and Ouster OS0-128; do not mix their calibrations.
en.Reference provenance: Ouster scans are registered by ICP to a Leica BLK360 survey map; poses are centimetre-level map-derived references, not mocap.
en.Coordinates: Original pose frame: RS_C1; multicamera extension: Base. CSV quaternions are x y z w.
en.Calibration and time: Version-specific Kalibr files include equidistant distortion for the multicamera extension; that extension uses hardware/PTP synchronization.
en.Evaluation: Suitable for SLAM, map reconstruction and relocalization; report map-registration dependence.

zh.版本: 原始版为 RealSense D435i 与 Ouster OS1；扩展为四个 Alphasense 相机与 OS0-128，不可混用标定。
zh.参考来源: Ouster 扫描经 ICP 配准到 Leica BLK360 测量地图；位姿为厘米级地图推导参考，不是动作捕捉。
zh.坐标约定: 原始位姿坐标系为 RS_C1，多相机版为 Base；CSV 四元数顺序为 x y z w。
zh.标定与时间: 对应版本的 Kalibr 文件分别使用；多相机扩展采用等距畸变模型和硬件/PTP 同步。
zh.评测: 适合 SLAM、地图重建和重定位；需说明参考位姿对地图配准的依赖。

en: A point cloud is not automatically a dense per-pixel depth map.
The 2025 Oxford Spires successor is catalogued separately.
zh: 点云不能自动等同于逐像素稠密深度。
2025 年后继数据 Oxford Spires 另有独立条目。

evidence.title: Newer College official version overview
Newer College ICP references and pose frames
Newer College download and licence
Multicamera extension paper
Newer College multicamera distortion and synchronization

license.en: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; registration is required for downloads.

summary.en: Repeated urban traversals across weather and seasons with stereo and 180° fisheye views, useful for long-term localisation.
summary.zh: 跨天气、季节反复采集的城市路线，含双目与 180° 鱼眼视图，适合长期定位研究。

en.Geometry: Forward trinocular stereo plus left/right/rear fisheye cameras; source images are unrectified Bayer PNGs.
en.Reference quality: Use the separate 2020 RTK release and its validity flags for global evaluation; original GPS/INS quality varies.
en.Not ground truth: vo.csv is a drifting local visual-odometry reference, explicitly not global or relative-pose ground truth.
en.Calibration and timing: Intrinsics, rectification lookup tables, extrinsics and per-sensor timestamps are supplied; sensors have different rates.
en.Year and evaluation: 2017 is the journal volume year (online publication 2016). Specify traversal split, RTK coverage and the coordinate transform.

zh.成像模型: 前向三目加左/右/后三个鱼眼相机；原图为未经校正的 Bayer PNG。
zh.参考质量: 全局评测采用单独发布的 2020 年 RTK 参考及有效标记；原始 GPS/INS 的质量随场景变化。
zh.非真值数据: vo.csv 只是会漂移的局部视觉里程计参考，官方明确不把它当作相对或全局位姿真值。
zh.标定与时间: 提供内参、校正查找表、外参与各传感器时间戳；不同传感器采样率不同。
zh.年份与评测: 2017 为期刊卷年，2016 年在线发表；需说明路线划分、RTK 覆盖与坐标变换。

en: Do not merge this release with the Radar RobotCar extension without stating the version.
LiDAR projection is sparse supervision, not native dense-depth GT.
zh: 与 Radar RobotCar 扩展一起使用时需明确版本。
LiDAR 投影只能提供稀疏监督，并非原生稠密深度真值。

evidence.title: Oxford RobotCar overview, licence and registration
RobotCar sensor models and VO reference warning
2020 RTK ground-truth release

name: 360Loc
title: 360Loc: A Dataset and Benchmark for Omnidirectional Visual Localization with Cross-device Queries

license.en: No explicit dataset reuse licence located in the inspected official page/README; confirm with authors.
license.zh: 本次查看的官方页面/README 未找到明确数据复用许可，需向作者确认。

summary.en: Native panoramic reference/query images and LiDAR-assisted 6DoF poses for cross-camera localisation, including virtual fisheye and pinhole queries.
summary.zh: 提供原生全景参考/查询图像及 LiDAR 辅助六自由度位姿，用于跨相机定位，并可生成虚拟鱼眼和透视查询。

en.Task: Absolute 6DoF visual localisation against a mapped scene; not primarily a dense-depth benchmark.
en.Query generation: Official release keeps original 360° images and generates lower-FoV fisheye/pinhole queries with supplied camera configurations.
en.Pose provenance: 360° imagery and LiDAR mapping jointly establish metric reference poses.
en.Pose format: JSON stores camera-to-world transforms; text uses x y z qw qx qy qz. Follow the toolkit's COLMAP conventions.
en.Access: Official toolkit links downloads and supplies processing scripts; archive contents were not fully downloaded here.

zh.任务: 已建图场景中的绝对六自由度视觉定位，主要目标不是稠密深度评测。
zh.查询生成: 官方保留原始 360° 图像，使用相机配置生成较小视场的鱼眼/透视查询。
zh.位姿来源: 结合 360° 图像与 LiDAR 建图生成米制参考位姿。
zh.位姿格式: JSON 存储相机到世界变换；文本采用 x y z qw qx qy qz，遵循工具中的 COLMAP 约定。
zh.获取: 官方工具链接数据并提供处理脚本；本次未完整下载和解包归档。

en: No complete dense per-pixel depth GT is claimed.
Virtual fisheye queries are resampled views, not separate physical fisheye recordings.
zh: 不宣称具有完整逐像素深度真值。
虚拟鱼眼查询是重采样视图，不是另外采集的实体鱼眼图像。

evidence.title: 360Loc official project and mapping provenance
360Loc release, virtual cameras and pose formats
360Loc CVPR 2024 paper

license.en: Official code is GPL-3.0; a separate explicit dataset licence was not located in the inspected README.
license.zh: 官方代码为 GPL-3.0；查看的 README 未找到单独明确的数据许可。

summary.en: Indoor query panoramas with point-cloud maps and reference poses, designed for localisation under handheld/robot capture and scene changes.
summary.zh: 室内查询全景、点云地图及参考位姿，用于手持/机器人采集和场景变化条件下的定位。

en.Versions: Official repository links an original release and a newer expanded release; the consolidated localisation library explicitly uses the older version.
en.Geometry: Panoramic images and scene point clouds; not a synchronized multi-sensor VIO benchmark.
en.Pose convention: The current README gives the point transformation X_camera = R(X_world − t). Match parser to release version.
en.Ground truth: Per-query reference poses are supplied. The inspected README does not establish an independent motion-capture accuracy bound.
en.Depth use: Projecting the point cloud produces map-derived depths with holes/occlusions; no complete measured depth GT is assumed.

zh.版本: 官方仓库同时链接原始和扩展发布；综合定位库明确使用旧版，比较时需统一版本。
zh.成像模型: 全景图像与场景点云，不是同步多传感器 VIO 基准。
zh.位姿约定: 当前 README 给出 X_camera = R(X_world − t)；解析器需匹配版本。
zh.真值: 提供逐查询参考位姿；所查看的 README 未建立独立动作捕捉精度界限。
zh.深度使用: 投影点云得到的是带空洞/遮挡的地图推导深度，不假设完整实测深度真值。

en: Keep original/new scene splits separate in reported results.
Download links are present; full cloud archives were not downloaded in this audit.
zh: 报告结果时区分原始/新增场景划分。
官方提供下载链接，本次未下载完整点云归档。

evidence.title: PICCOLO official OmniScenes release and pose convention
Consolidated library: old OmniScenes version warning

name: PanoAir
title: PanoAir: A Panoramic Visual-Inertial SLAM with Cross-Time Real-World UAV Dataset

license.en: Repository is GPL-3.0; a separate dataset licence was not verified. Do not infer data rights from the code licence.
license.zh: 仓库标为 GPL-3.0；未核验单独数据许可，不根据代码许可推断数据权利。

summary.en: Real UAV panoramic-inertial sequences across illumination and flight conditions; the official Drive release is linked but archive access remains unverified.
summary.zh: 跨光照和飞行条件的真实无人机全景惯性序列；官方提供 Drive 数据链接，但本次未核验归档访问。

en.Inputs: 30 Hz stitched ERP; dual-fisheye ROS1 recordings and virtual pinhole sequences; 1000 Hz IMU.
en.Reference: README lists 5 Hz RTK trajectories. Inspect files/paper for position versus orientation coverage and antenna/body transforms before 6DoF evaluation.
en.Calibration: Camera intrinsics, IMU intrinsics, camera–IMU extrinsics and virtual-pinhole parameters are listed.
en.Release status: README says data/calibrations are on Google Drive; repository source-code release is still stated as after acceptance.
en.Evidence limit: No dense depth GT, complete-download check, or measured synchronization-error bound is asserted here.

zh.输入: 30 Hz 拼接 ERP、双鱼眼 ROS1 记录、虚拟透视序列，以及 1000 Hz IMU。
zh.参考: README 列出 5 Hz RTK 轨迹；六自由度评测前需检查文件/论文，核对位置与姿态覆盖及天线/机体变换。
zh.标定: 列出相机内参、IMU 内参、相机–IMU 外参及虚拟透视参数。
zh.发布状态: README 声称数据/标定可从 Google Drive 下载；代码仍写明接收后发布。
zh.证据限制: 本条目不宣称稠密深度真值、完整下载验证或已测同步误差界限。

en: Access marked unknown because the linked Drive archive was not downloaded or unpacked.
A linked dataset release does not imply the full SLAM code is released.
zh: 由于未下载和解包 Drive 归档，获取状态标为未知。
链接数据发布不代表完整 SLAM 代码已经发布。

evidence.title: PanoAir official README, sensor rates and release roadmap
PanoAir 2026 preprint

name: Aria Digital Twin
title: Aria Digital Twin: A New Benchmark Dataset for Egocentric 3D Machine Perception

license.en: Aria Digital Twin Dataset License Agreement; download implies acceptance. Tooling licences do not replace dataset terms.
license.zh: 遵循 Aria Digital Twin 数据集许可协议；下载即表示接受。工具许可不替代数据条款。

summary.en: Real egocentric fisheye recordings paired with motion-capture/digital-twin ground truth; rendered depth and estimated MPS products are explicitly distinct.
summary.zh: 真实第一视角鱼眼记录配合动作捕捉/数字孪生真值，明确区分渲染深度与 MPS 估计产物。

en.Geometry and data: Aria raw RGB, two monochrome camera streams, IMUs, calibrations and synchronized ground-truth products in VRS/CSV.
en.Depth convention: ADT depth_images.vrs stores camera-Z depth in millimetres, unlike ASE ray distances; convert units before backprojection.
en.Pose provenance: aria_trajectory.csv is generated by the ADT GT system. MPS open/closed-loop trajectories and semidense points are estimates.
en.Coordinates and time: Ground truth and aligned MPS outputs use the ADT scene frame; use stream timestamps and alignment metadata.
en.Dynamic coverage: Select body-mesh-occlusion versus no-body depth consistently; not every sequence has body-skeleton GT.

zh.成像与数据: Aria 原始 RGB、两路灰度相机、IMU、标定与同步真值，以 VRS/CSV 提供。
zh.深度约定: ADT 的 depth_images.vrs 为毫米单位的相机 Z 深度，区别于 ASE 的射线距离；反投影前先换算单位。
zh.位姿来源: aria_trajectory.csv 来自 ADT 真值系统；MPS 开/闭环轨迹及半稠密点云是估计结果。
zh.坐标与时间: 真值及对齐后的 MPS 数据使用 ADT 场景坐标系；按各流时间戳及对齐元数据读取。
zh.动态覆盖: 一致选择包含人体网格遮挡或不含人体的深度；并非每个序列都有骨架真值。

en: Mixed means real observations plus rendered digital-twin annotations, not measured RGB-D depth.
Do not count MPS estimates as independent pose GT; website/paper sequence totals vary with release version.
zh: “混合”指真实观测加数字孪生渲染标签，不是实测 RGB-D 深度。
MPS 估计不能当作独立位姿真值；网页与论文序列总数随发布版本变化。

evidence.title: ADT official dataset overview
ADT Z-depth units, GT/MPS separation and coordinates
ADT download, sign-up and licence agreement
ADT ICCV 2023 dataset paper

name: LaFiDa
title: LaFiDa – A Laserscanner Multi-Fisheye Camera Dataset

license.en: CC BY 4.0, as stated by KIT IPF.
license.zh: KIT IPF 声明采用 CC BY 4.0。

summary.en: Helmet-mounted three-fisheye/laser benchmark with motion-capture references and explicit camera/rig calibration.
summary.zh: 头盔式三鱼眼/激光基准，提供动作捕捉参考和明确的相机/机架标定。

en.Geometry: Three divergent physical fisheye cameras and a laser scanner; not an ERP panorama stream.
en.Reference provenance: OptiTrack tracks a rigid-body marker bar; apply its measured camera/scanner transforms for sensor-frame evaluation.
en.Accuracy: Official description distinguishes stable submillimetre position precision from dynamic errors of a few millimetres.
en.Calibration and time: Ocam-Toolbox intrinsics, multicamera/laser/rigid-body extrinsics and per-image/scan timestamps are documented.
en.Task: SLAM trajectory ATE/RPE and mapping on indoor/outdoor static/dynamic sequences; laser returns are not complete image-depth GT.

zh.成像模型: 三个朝向不同的真实鱼眼相机和激光扫描仪，不是 ERP 全景流。
zh.参考来源: OptiTrack 跟踪刚性标记杆；评估传感器轨迹时需应用相机/扫描仪到刚体的标定变换。
zh.精度: 官方区分静态亚毫米级位置精度与动态数毫米误差。
zh.标定与时间: 说明 Ocam-Toolbox 内参、多相机/激光/刚体外参及逐图像/扫描时间戳。
zh.任务: 室内外静态/动态序列的 SLAM 轨迹 ATE/RPE 和建图；激光回波不等于完整图像深度真值。

en: The outdoor large-loop sequence leaves the tracking volume; its full path does not have continuous mocap.
Full archives were not downloaded; download entry points are linked from the official project.
zh: 室外大回环序列离开动作捕捉范围，全程并非都有连续动作捕捉真值。
本次未下载完整归档；下载入口由官方项目页提供。

evidence.title: KIT IPF official LaFiDa release and CC BY 4.0 licence
LaFiDa motion capture, calibration and synchronization
LaFiDa downloads, units and outdoor tracking-volume limitation

name: Oxford Spires
title: The Oxford Spires Dataset: Benchmarking Large-Scale LiDAR-Visual Localisation, Reconstruction and Radiance Field Methods

license.en: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; intended for non-commercial academic use.
license.zh: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0，面向非商业学术用途。

summary.en: Three colour fisheye views and survey maps for large-scale localisation/reconstruction; official tools can derive sparse image depth from LiDAR.
summary.zh: 三路彩色鱼眼与测量地图构成的大尺度定位/重建基准，官方工具可由 LiDAR 生成图像稀疏深度。

en.Inputs: Three global-shutter colour fisheyes at 20 Hz, Hesai QT64 LiDAR at 10 Hz and camera-synchronized IMU at 400 Hz.
en.Independent map: Leica RTC360 TLS provides millimetre-accurate reference geometry.
en.Pose reference: Core sequences have centimetre-accurate LiDAR poses registered to the TLS map; poses give base-to-world transforms.
en.Derived depth: Official script projects undistorted LiDAR clouds into cameras. These are scan-derived sparse depths, not dense independent depth labels.
en.Data hygiene: Calibration and raw recordings are supplied. Keep VILENS-SLAM/COLMAP outputs separate from survey GT.

zh.输入: 三路 20 Hz 全局快门彩色鱼眼、10 Hz Hesai QT64 LiDAR，以及与相机同步的 400 Hz IMU。
zh.独立地图: Leica RTC360 地面激光扫描提供毫米级参考几何。
zh.位姿参考: 核心序列提供配准到测量地图的厘米级 LiDAR 位姿，为基座到世界变换。
zh.推导深度: 官方脚本将去畸变 LiDAR 点云投到相机，所得为扫描推导的稀疏深度，并非稠密独立深度标签。
zh.数据区分: 提供标定与原始记录；VILENS-SLAM/COLMAP 输出需与测量真值分开。

en: Not all sequences have the core localisation ground-truth trajectory.
TLS map accuracy and trajectory-registration accuracy are different quantities.
2025 denotes public release/acceptance; the preprint first appeared in 2024.
zh: 并非所有序列都具有核心定位基准的真值轨迹。
地面扫描地图精度与轨迹配准精度是不同指标。
2025 对应公开发布/接收年份；预印本首发于 2024 年。

evidence.title: Oxford Spires official sensors, references, core sequences and licence
Oxford Spires official downloader and depth-image generation
Oxford Spires dataset paper

name: 360DVO Dataset
title: 360DVO: Deep Visual Odometry for Monocular 360-Degree Camera — real-world benchmark

zh: 不同来源的 360° RGB 视频

license.en: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, as declared by the official Hugging Face dataset card; original video provenance remains documented in the paper.
license.zh: 官方 Hugging Face 数据卡声明 CC BY-NC-SA 4.0；原始视频来源仍需参考论文。

summary.en: Real panoramic video benchmark with 20 Easy/Hard sequences and Agisoft Metashape trajectory references; these are SfM pseudo ground truth, not independent tracking measurements.
summary.zh: 包含 20 段 Easy/Hard 真实全景视频及 Agisoft Metashape 参考轨迹；位姿属于 SfM 伪真值，不是独立跟踪测量。

en.Projection and timing: ERP RGB frames are standardized to 3840×1920 at 10 FPS. The paper also evaluates derived 90-degree, 640×640 perspective views; these are crops/reprojections, not extra physical cameras.
en.Capture provenance: Three sequences come from 360VOTS, fifteen from internet videos, and two from Hong Kong tram recordings. A common physical camera/IMU rig and shared hardware calibration are not established.
en.Pose reference: Agisoft Metashape SfM produces the pseudo-reference trajectories. No independent motion capture, RTK, or dense measured depth is claimed.
en.Evaluation and scale: Easy and Hard each contain ten sequences. The paper uses Sim(3) Umeyama alignment, reports ATE in meters and RPE in m/frame and deg/frame, and evaluates overlapping trajectory segments. Independent absolute metric calibration of each real sequence is not established.
en.Access and version: The official HF repository is public and ungated, with Sequences/ and twenty GroundTruth/ files listed. Full image payloads were not downloaded. HF createdAt is 2026-01-04; this is an older omission, not an October release.

zh.投影与时间: ERP RGB 统一为 3840×1920、10 FPS。论文另评估 90°、640×640 的派生透视视图；它们是裁剪/重投影，不是额外真实相机。
zh.采集来源: 3 段来自 360VOTS，15 段来自网络视频，2 段为香港电车实录；未建立共同的相机/IMU 机架或统一硬件标定。
zh.位姿参考: 参考轨迹由 Agisoft Metashape SfM 产生；不宣称独立动作捕捉、RTK 或稠密实测深度。
zh.评测与尺度: Easy/Hard 各 10 段。论文采用 Sim(3) Umeyama 对齐，ATE 用米、平移/旋转 RPE 用米/帧和度/帧，仅评估轨迹重叠段。各真实序列的独立绝对公制标定未获证实。
zh.获取与版本: 官方 HF 仓库公开、无门控，列有 Sequences/ 及 20 个 GroundTruth/ 文件；未下载完整图像。HF 创建于 2026-01-04，本轮属于补漏，不能称为十月新发布。

en: HF's automatic train split and viewer row count are storage/viewer artifacts, not the paper's Easy/Hard evaluation protocol.
No dense depth GT is inferred from the VO method's internal patch depths; pose serialization, timestamps and scale must be checked before using a new loader.
zh: HF 自动生成的 train 划分和预览行数是存储/预览产物，不等于论文的 Easy/Hard 评测协议。
不根据 VO 方法内部的图像块深度推断稠密深度真值；使用新加载器前需核对位姿文件格式、时间戳和尺度。

evidence.title: Official dataset card: release, SfM reference, sequence groups and licence
Official HF API: ungated public access, creation date and twenty reference files
Paper sections IV and V-B: source videos, pseudo GT and Sim(3) evaluation
Official method and dataset project

name: ODGS-SLAM Dataset
title: ODGS-SLAM Dataset: synthetic and real omnidirectional motion sequences

zh: 真实全景的立体估计深度

license.en: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, explicitly recorded in the official University of Innsbruck repository API metadata.
license.zh: 因斯布鲁克大学官方数据仓库 API 元数据明确声明 CC BY-NC-SA 4.0。

summary.en: Public synthetic indoor/outdoor and real indoor SLAM sequences compare ERP, six-fisheye rigs and perspective inputs; rendered depths, mocap poses and estimated real depths have distinct provenance.
summary.zh: 公开的合成室内/室外与真实室内 SLAM 序列，对比 ERP、六鱼眼机架及透视输入；需区分渲染深度、动作捕捉位姿和真实图像的估计深度。

en.Subsets and provenance: Indoor room and outdoor urban subsets are fully synthetic Blender Cycles renders, not photogrammetric real scans. The real subset records a myAGV robot indoors; five Insta360 Pro and eight X4 sequences are documented.
en.Physical camera outputs: Real Pro data includes six 1440×1920 fisheye streams at 30 FPS and 1920×960 stitched ERP. X4 provides 3840×1920 stitched ERP at 60 FPS, without separate physical lens images in this release.
en.Depth provenance: Synthetic ERP/pinhole EXR depths are rendered; real Pro panorama EXR depths come from sphere-sweeping stereo and are estimates. The real X4 listing contains RGB, poses and robot masks, not depth. Depth encoding units and range-versus-Z are not settled by the inspected READMEs.
en.Pose and synchronization: Real OptiTrack tracks three markers with the reference origin at the camera mount; video alignment is manual. Apply the documented mount-specific Y rotation. Synthetic poses use Blender coordinates; both versions store XYZ Euler angles in radians. Translation units and a synchronization error bound are not specified in the inspected READMEs.
en.Calibration and protocols: MC-Calib YAML provides the Pro multicamera calibration. Synthetic views simulate that rig and also offer a 113-degree perspective camera. Choose the documented subset/sequence: some retracing data has only Camera_0; no universal train/validation/test split is asserted.
en.Access and version: University archive DOI 10.48323/z6f6r-sjc65, v1.0.0, published 2026-04-17. Three ZIPs and their separate small READMEs are publicly listed; only READMEs/API metadata were read. This is an older omission, not a new October dataset.

zh.子集与来源: 室内房间及室外城市子集均由 Blender Cycles 完全合成，并非真实扫描后摄影测量的场景；真实子集在室内记录 myAGV，列有 5 段 Pro 和 8 段 X4 序列。
zh.真实相机输出: Pro 包含 6 路 1440×1920、30 FPS 鱼眼及 1920×960 拼接 ERP；X4 提供 3840×1920、60 FPS 拼接 ERP，本发布不含独立镜头图像。
zh.深度来源: 合成 ERP/透视 EXR 深度来自渲染；真实 Pro 全景 EXR 深度由球面扫描立体算法估计。真实 X4 列表包含 RGB、位姿和机器人掩码，不含深度。所读 README 未确定深度编码单位及径向距离/Z 定义。
zh.位姿与同步: 真实 OptiTrack 跟踪三个标记点，参考原点为相机安装位置；视频按运动模式手工对时，并需应用各安装配置的 Y 轴补偿旋转。合成位姿采用 Blender 坐标；两者 XYZ 欧拉角均为弧度。所读 README 未说明平移单位或同步误差界限。
zh.标定与协议: MC-Calib YAML 提供 Pro 多相机标定；合成视图模拟该机架，另含 113° 透视相机。按明确子集/序列选择数据；部分折返数据仅含 Camera_0，不宣称统一训练/验证/测试划分。
zh.获取与版本: 大学仓库 DOI 为 10.48323/z6f6r-sjc65，v1.0.0 发布于 2026-04-17。公开列出 3 个 ZIP 和各自小型 README；仅阅读说明/API，未下载完整数据。本轮属于旧遗漏补充。

en: Do not score the real stereo-estimated depth as an independent measured depth ground truth.
Synthetic camera-to-world uses Blender +Z up and optical axis −Z; real data uses world +Y up plus mount offsets. A single unchanged pose parser is unsafe across subsets.
A public archive listing establishes an access route, not a completed integrity or full-download test.
zh: 不能把真实序列的立体估计深度当作独立实测深度真值。
合成相机到世界采用 Blender 的 +Z 向上、光轴 −Z；真实数据世界 +Y 向上且有安装旋转。不同子集不能未经转换共用位姿解析器。
公开归档列表证明存在获取入口，不代表已完成全量下载和完整性校验。

evidence.title: Official university dataset archive, DOI, versions and files
Official metadata API including explicit CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 rights
Official real recording README: cameras, estimated depth, mocap and manual alignment
Official synthetic indoor README: rendering, calibration and pose coordinates
Official synthetic outdoor README: urban Blender renders and camera modalities

name: PanoCARLA-Static
title: PanoCARLA-Static: static-scene panoramic RGB-D video with moving virtual cameras

zh: CARLA 0.9.16 虚拟 RGB/深度/语义相机
仿真相机位置与偏航角

license.en: CC BY 4.0 for the dataset, stated in the official card. Cite PVDepth; the collection repository's MIT code licence is separate.
license.zh: 官方数据卡声明数据为 CC BY 4.0；使用时引用 PVDepth，采集仓库的 MIT 代码许可单独适用。

summary.en: October 2026 HF release of static-scene CARLA panoramas with moving cameras, radial metric depth and simulator poses; shared route names do not make it pose-matched to dynamic PanoCARLA.
summary.zh: 2026 年 10 月发布到 HF 的 CARLA 静态场景全景序列，含移动相机、径向公制深度和仿真位姿；同名路线并不与动态 PanoCARLA 逐帧同位姿。

en.Release and access: Official HF API records creation on 2026-10-07 and update on 2026-10-08, with private=false and gated=false at this check. These dates describe this data repository, not the first publication date of the ICML 2026 PVDepth paper. Large data files were not downloaded.
en.Coverage and capture: The card lists 127,334 frames, 127 clips, 67 routes and eight towns at 20 FPS. Vehicles/pedestrians are removed while the camera moves with varying height. Six synchronized virtual views produce ERP; they are not a physical stereo rig or measured baseline.
en.Depth and validity: HDF5 depth is float16 [T,1200,2400,1] radial distance in meters. Capture code decodes CARLA depth with a 1000-meter scale; stitching converts optical-axis depth to ray distance. Check finite/positive validity and sky/far-plane masking for the selected evaluation; the 1000-meter source scale is not an ERP valid-depth cutoff.
en.Pose and coordinates: Float32 poses store x,y,z in CARLA world meters and yaw in degrees; pitch and roll are fixed at zero and omitted. Use each release's supplied poses, not a newly generated path or a dynamic-release trajectory.
en.Formats and indexing: RGB is uint8 [T,1200,2400,3]; segmentation uses uint8 CARLA IDs. setting_static.json maps frame IDs to HDF5 paths/indices. Collision/gap filtering creates clip boundaries; preview videos include excluded frames and do not share HDF5 indexing.
en.Evaluation and relation: Static and dynamic variants reuse overall routes but regenerate camera-height motion, so they are not pixel/pose-aligned pairs. Preserve town/route identity when splitting data; the card does not define a separate static train/validation/test benchmark.

zh.发布与获取: 官方 HF API 记录仓库于 2026-10-07 创建、10-08 更新，本次核验 private=false、gated=false。这是该数据仓库的日期，不是 ICML 2026 PVDepth 论文首发日期；未下载完整大文件。
zh.覆盖与采集: 数据卡列出 127334 帧、127 个片段、67 条路线、8 个城镇，20 FPS。移除车辆和行人，相机仍移动且高度变化；6 个同步虚拟视图生成 ERP，不是真实立体机架或实测基线。
zh.深度与有效性: HDF5 深度为 float16 [T,1200,2400,1]、米制径向距离。采集代码以 1000 米缩放解码 CARLA 深度，拼接时将光轴深度转为射线距离。按选定评测检查有限/正值、天空和远平面掩码；1000 米源缩放不能直接当作 ERP 有效深度上限。
zh.位姿与坐标: float32 位姿存储 CARLA 世界坐标的米制 x,y,z 和角度制 yaw；pitch、roll 固定为零而省略。几何计算应使用本版本位姿，不能借用新生成路线或动态版轨迹。
zh.格式与索引: RGB 为 uint8 [T,1200,2400,3]，语义为 uint8 CARLA 类别。setting_static.json 将源帧号映射到 HDF5 路径/索引；碰撞和帧号空隙决定片段边界，预览视频包含被剔除帧，不可与 HDF5 索引混用。
zh.评测与关联: 静态/动态版复用大致路线，但重新随机生成相机高度，因此不是逐像素、逐位姿对齐的数据对。划分应保留城镇/路线身份；数据卡未定义单独的静态版训练/验证/测试基准。

en: This is synthetic annotation, not measured physical depth or independently tracked real poses; yaw-only orientation limits motion diversity.
The original dynamic PanoCARLA repository is currently gated; access policies must be checked separately for each release.
HF viewer failure does not establish missing downloadable files; access=open is based on current public ungated repository metadata.
